translations.en: I took a deep breath and calmed myself.

translations.en: The two people’s breathing is perfectly in sync.
translations.cs: Dech těch dvou je úplně sladěný.

translations.yue: 兩個人嘅呼吸完全一致。
translations.zh-Hans: 两个人的呼吸完全一致。

translations.en: I took a breath and then spoke again.

translations.el: Πήρα μια ανάσα και μετά μίλησα ξανά.

translations.nb: Jeg tok et pust og snakket videre.
translations.nl: Ik haalde adem en praatte daarna verder.
translations.pl: Wziąłem oddech i potem mówiłem dalej.
translations.pt: Parei para respirar e depois falei de novo.
translations.ro: Am luat o gură de aer și apoi am vorbit din nou.
translations.ru: Я перевёл дыхание и снова заговорил.
translations.sv: Jag tog ett andetag och fortsatte sedan att prata.
translations.tr: Bir nefes aldım ve sonra আবার konuştum.

translations.vi: Tôi hít thở một chút rồi nói tiếp.
